Ordinance Octe BER 22, 2024

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-
Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 10-Tin
the area bound by:

A line 24 feet north of and parallel to West 45th Street; South California Avenue;
West 45th Street; and the public alley next west of and parallel to South California
Avenue.

to those of B2-1.5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4458 South California Avenue, Chicago, Ilinois.
